verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a media-over-QUIC relay/CDN server that connects publishers to subscribers. It is not an agent or AI assistant that would consume tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
